defs.def: to have air come suddenly and noisily out through your nose and mouth in a way that you cannot control, for example because you have a cold 打喷嚏noun

ex.s: This allows it to take in air at 30 times the speed of a human sneeze, enabling it to drink 3L of water a second.
ex.t: 这使得它以人类喷嚏速度的30倍的速度在空气中摄取,使其能一秒饮用3L的水.

ex.s: It lets out 64% more air when sneezing.
ex.t: 它打喷嚏时呼出的气体多64%。

ex.s: Carrying out these everyday tasks effectively helps the astronauts stay healthy and focus on their work in space – after all, imagine what would happen if they caught a cold and started to sneeze!
ex.t: 执行这些日常任务有效地帮助宇航员保持健康,并专注于在太空的工作——毕竟,想象一下如果他们感冒并开始打喷嚏会发生什么事!

ex.s: It affects the 2 and is passed on through tiny drops of saliva released when someone coughs or sneezes.
ex.t: 它影响呼吸系统，通过患者咳嗽或打喷嚏时释放的微小唾液飞沫传播。
